brief: A 6-second loading screen: a circular progress ring fills from 0% to 100% with the percentage counting up in the centre, then the ring pulses once.
checks: Yes/No: A circular progress ring is present in the scene.
Yes/No: A percentage numeral is visible in the centre of the ring.
Yes/No: The ring’s fill progresses from 0% (empty) to 100% (full) over the duration.
Yes/No: The percentage number counts up from 0 to 100 in sync with the ring’s fill.
Yes/No: After reaching 100%, the ring executes a single pulse (scale‑up‑then‑down) and then stops.
Yes/No: The pulse occurs only after the fill is complete; there is no pulsing during the filling phase.
Yes/No: The percentage text is at least about one‑tenth of the frame height and has high contrast against its background.
Yes/No: No graphical element touches or crosses any edge of the frame.
Yes/No: The ring and the percentage text are concentrically aligned (the text is centered inside the ring) with even spacing.
Yes/No: The fill animation eases in and out (starts slow, speeds up, then slows down) rather than moving at a constant speed.
Yes/No: At least one visual change (ring progress or number update) occurs in every one‑second interval, so there is no dead air.
Yes/No: The animation begins immediately; no new element appears before the 0.5‑second mark (no empty opening).
Yes/No: After the final pulse, the image remains static for at least 0.5 seconds before the video ends.
